messages:
sara.docs: opened a docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — 'region-aware routing & fallback docs' :wave:

sara.docs: blocker: need a clear statement on whether request params are preserved when SmartRouting falls back to a different model. this affects the example in the migration guide where we rely on stop tokens being honored after fallback.

kevin.runtime: short answer — runtime preserves the incoming request fields (temperature, top_p, stop, max_tokens, function_call, user-provided meta) when we route to a fallback model. we only substitute the model id and the tokenization heuristics for max length.

jia.api: confirm — so examples should show the client always setting the params and not expecting model defaults?

kevin.runtime: yes. please make the docs explicit: do not rely on server defaults for things like stop or temperature if you need deterministic behavior. runtime sets preserve_request_params = true for SmartRouting.

oliver.ml: one edge-case: if fallback goes from a BPE model to an encoder-decoder-ish variant, token counting may differ and max_tokens truncation can vary. add a caveat in the note.

sara.docs: thanks — i'll add a sentence and an example snippet. quick question about the example code formatting for the SDK snippets — should we show the raw REST body or the new JS SDK call?

jia.api: include both short JS SDK and minimal REST, like we do in other pages. small snippets only.

sara.docs: pushing an update in the PR now. also FYI docs-preview-bot says the Netlify preview linkcheck failed on one relative link (dedicated vs private):

docs-preview-bot: "Preview build #2784 finished — status: linkcheck_failed" — https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/preview/432

sara.docs: that link is from the local anchor we added in the migration guide. i'll fix it, but i need final engineering ack before requesting merge since this text clarifies runtime behavior.

kevin.runtime: acked. once you include the kernel caveat from oliver and the two snippets, i'm fine approving. 

jia.api: i'll review the SDK snippet once it's pushed. can we target a quick merge window after CI passes? we prefer merges before EOD Pacific to avoid late-stage rollouts.

sara.docs: plan: push changes in 10m, wait for docs-preview-bot to re-run, then request reviews. if both kevin and jia approve and Netlify linkcheck is green, i'll merge before 1700 PT. sound good?

kevin.runtime: sounds good. if anything unexpected pops up ping me directly.

oliver.ml: added minor wording suggestion in comments — not blocking.

sara.docs: updated the PR with: (1) explicit sentence "Runtime preserves client request parameters when routing to fallback models; do not rely on model defaults for deterministic behavior." (2) SDK + REST snippets and the tokenizer caveat.

docs-preview-bot: "Preview build #2785 finished — status: success" — https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/preview/432

jia.api: LGTM on snippets. one tiny nit about a code fence language tag.

kevin.runtime: approving now. go ahead and merge after the CI green. :thumbsup:

sara.docs: merging in 5, will watch metrics in case of any doc-related regressions. thanks all! :rocket:
